for_overall.description: The overall pick number this verdict is for. Copied from the packet. A verdict for the wrong pick is ignored.

agree.description: True when the dossiers do not contradict the board. This is the expected answer.

veto.description: Candidates that must not be taken this pick. Each needs a dossier fact and a section citation.

cites.description: Playbook sections, e.g. "§3.7". An uncited lever is refused.

dossier_fact.description: The specific line from this player's dossier that justifies it. Not your own knowledge.

reorder.description: Move espn_id directly above above_espn_id. Both must be in the same tier and both in the candidate list.

summary.description: Two or three sentences for Slack: what the board says, what the dossiers add, what you changed.

flags.description: Anything worth a human's attention that is not a lever — a gap in the dossiers, a candidate you could not assess.
